section_1_data_overview.columns_kind: season, day, home, away, oh/od/oa (odds), h/a (goals), total, gg, o25, half_time, first_goal, outcome

section_2_outcome_distribution.key_insight: The odds market is highly efficient. Actual and implied probabilities align within 0.1%, meaning no systematic edge exists in the overall market.

section_3_odds_efficiency.key_insight: Higher confidence = higher accuracy, but the market prices this in. Even at 70%+ confidence, ROI is negative due to odds adjusting down.

section_4_edge_patterns.key_insight: Smallest edges found in mid-odds ranges (1.8-3.0). Strong favorites (1.2-1.5) return actual close to implied. Weak favorites (2.0-3.0) slightly outperform market expectations.

section_5_team_ratings.outlier_insight: MANCHESTER BLUE dominates at home (63.4%) but LIVERPOOL has the best away record (49.5%). FULHAM (24.5% home) and BOURNEMOUTH (13.3% away) are the weakest.

section_6_half_time_full_time.key_insight: HT lead is highly predictive. Home teams leading at HT win 82.2% of the time. Away teams leading at HT win 75.0%. A HT draw is the most uncertain state.

section_7_first_goal.key_insight: First goal is the strongest predictor. Home scoring first → 75.9% win rate. Away scoring first → 66.5% win rate. 0-0 is the only guaranteed draw.

section_9_sovereign_ledger_audit.worst_strategy: GLOBAL DRAW SURGE — only 15-20% accurate across all variants
section_9_sovereign_ledger_audit.draw_prediction_performance: 19.9% — dramatically worse than natural draw rate of ~25%
section_9_sovereign_ledger_audit.zero_stake_bets: 283 WEAK bets had 0 stake (no real P&L impact; used for monitoring)
section_9_sovereign_ledger_audit.key_insight: The sovereign model is a significant net loser at -82% ROI. The odds-favored prediction (52.2%) outperforms sovereign predictions (41.4%) by ~10 percentage points. Draw predictions are the weakest link — only 19.9% accurate vs natural rate of ~25%.

section_10_recommendations.do_not_use_sovereign_draw_predictions: The GLOBAL DRAW SURGE strategy and draw predictions perform at 15-20% accuracy - far below the natural draw rate. Avoid.
section_10_recommendations.favorite_betting_is_negative_roi: Flat-betting all favorites yields -6.8% ROI long-term (as expected in a market with vigorish).
section_10_recommendations.leverage_ht_ft_correlation: Teams leading at HT have 75-82% win rates — the strongest in-play signal available.
section_10_recommendations.value_in_mid_range_favorites: Smallest negative edges in odds 1.8-3.0 range. Weak favorites (odds 2.0-3.0) show the closest-to-breakeven performance.
section_10_recommendations.monitor_sovereign_SIGNAL_LOCK: SIGNAL and LOCK tiers have small sample sizes (115 total) but significant negative ROI. Either the model needs retraining or the staking strategy needs adjustment.
section_10_recommendations.model_recalibration_needed: The sovereign model's 41.4% overall accuracy suggests a fundamental flaw. A simple 'favorite wins' model (52.2%) dramatically outperforms it. Re-examine prediction methodology.
section_10_recommendations.best_approach: Use odds-favored predictions as baseline (52.2% accuracy). Filter by probability threshold ≥ 60% for higher confidence (67.1% accuracy). Use first-goal and HT-lead signals for in-play decisions.
